name: Liberty Stories: Reimagined
desc:
CONSOLE, PC AND MOBILE SUPPORTED.
Liberty Stories is a game based in the harsh streets of New York.

- Level up your character, Buy guns 🔫, cars 🚗 and customize your character🙍
- Fight other players in intense combat ⚔️
- Become a police officer and keep the streets safe 👮
- Join a gang and protect your turf 🏠
- Make money through many money methods 💸
- Upgrade and customize your vehicles 🏎️
- And discover much more on your own!

[CONTROLS]
/pay to take out money
/passitem to give item on mobile

This is a remake of the original Liberty Stories.
